title: /integrations/hitron_coda
description: Instructions on how to integrate Hitron CODA Routers into Home Assistant.
body:
The **Rogers Hitron CODA**  offers presence detection by examining devices connected to a [Rogers Hitron CODA](https://www.rogers.com/customer/support/article/wi-fi-password-hitron-coda4582-cgn3amr-cgnm3552-cgn3acr-cgn3)
or [Shaw Hitron CGNM](https://community.shaw.ca/docs/DOC-4066) Router.

To use a Hitron router in your installation, add the following to your `configuration.yaml` file.

```yaml
# Example configuration.yaml entry
device_tracker:
  - platform: hitron_coda
    host: !secret router_ip
    username: !secret router_username
    password: !secret router_password
    type: rogers
```

```yaml
host:
  description: The IP address of your router, e.g., `192.168.0.1`.
  required: true
  type: string
username:
  description: The username to log in to the router (user should have read access to the web interface of the router). Usually "cusadmin".
  required: true
  type: string
password:
  description: The password for the specified username. Usually your Wi-Fi password.
  required: true
  type: string
type:
  description: The internet provider for the modem; "rogers" or "shaw". Defaults to "rogers".
  required: false
  type: string
```

See the [device tracker integration page](/integrations/device_tracker/) for instructions how to configure the people to be tracked.
